candidates.name: .NET File.ResolveLinkTarget
verified_facts: ResolveLinkTarget obtains a file link target and can follow to the final target
It returns null when the specified path is not a link
semantic_limits: Link resolution must fail closed on loops, missing targets, or escape outside the canonical work root

candidates.name: .NET Directory.ResolveLinkTarget
verified_facts: Directory.ResolveLinkTarget resolves symbolic links and junctions
Final-target resolution follows a bounded number of links and can report excessive link depth
semantic_limits: A resolved directory must still be normalized and checked for containment under the expected work root

candidates.name: .NET FileSystemInfo.ResolveLinkTarget
verified_facts: ResolveLinkTarget returns immediate or final link targets for file or directory objects
It returns null when the object is not a link
semantic_limits: Null means non-link, not automatically trusted path; canonical root, volume, and ACL checks still apply

candidates.name: .NET File.GetAttributes
verified_facts: GetAttributes retrieves FileAttributes for a path
Relative paths are interpreted against the current working directory
semantic_limits: Attribute readback must use normalized absolute paths and cannot prove file content integrity

candidates.name: .NET FileAttributes
verified_facts: FileAttributes includes ReparsePoint, Hidden, ReadOnly, Directory, and other flags
ReparsePoint indicates user-defined reparse data associated with a file or directory
semantic_limits: Attribute flags are metadata and must be correlated with resolved path, bytes, ACL, and intended receipt type

candidates.name: .NET Path.GetRelativePath
verified_facts: GetRelativePath computes a relative path from one absolute path to another
Path comparison follows platform-specific case rules
semantic_limits: A relative result containing parent traversal or rooted output must fail the canonical-root containment gate

candidates.name: ScheduledTasks module
verified_facts: The ScheduledTasks module includes Get-ScheduledTask, Get-ScheduledTaskInfo, and Export-ScheduledTask
Read-only inspection cmdlets are distinct from start, stop, register, set, and unregister operations
semantic_limits: Module availability does not prove task registration, task ownership, execution success, or receipt freshness

candidates.name: Get-ScheduledTask
verified_facts: Get-ScheduledTask returns definition objects for registered scheduled tasks
Task name and task path can be used to target a specific registration
semantic_limits: A registered definition does not prove a current running instance or successful last run

candidates.name: Get-ScheduledTaskInfo
verified_facts: Get-ScheduledTaskInfo returns last run-time information for a scheduled task
It can accept a task name or a task object from Get-ScheduledTask
semantic_limits: Runtime information can be stale and must be correlated with current time, task identity, and actual process state

candidates.name: Export-ScheduledTask
verified_facts: Export-ScheduledTask exports a registered task definition as XML
The XML can preserve actions, triggers, principal, and settings for readback
semantic_limits: Exported XML proves registration configuration only, not execution or the correctness of produced receipts

candidates.name: schtasks query
verified_facts: schtasks query displays tasks scheduled to run and supports verbose, XML, and HRESULT output
Task name can target a specific registered task
semantic_limits: Text or XML query output must be captured with exit code and exact task path; it does not prove live engine ownership

candidates.name: TaskService object
verified_facts: TaskService provides access to registered tasks and running tasks
Connect must be called before other TaskService methods
semantic_limits: Successful service connection does not establish that a specific task is registered, running, or authorized

candidates.name: TaskService.GetFolder
verified_facts: GetFolder retrieves a folder of registered tasks by path
The root task folder is addressed by a backslash in Task Scheduler APIs
semantic_limits: Folder access does not prove a target task exists; exact task name and registration must be read separately

candidates.name: ITaskFolder.GetTasks
verified_facts: GetTasks returns a collection of registered tasks in a folder
The returned collection can be enumerated for exact names and paths
semantic_limits: Folder enumeration may omit hidden tasks unless flags and permissions are appropriate and must not infer absence broadly

candidates.name: IRegisteredTask.State
verified_facts: IRegisteredTask State returns the operational state of a registered task
TASK_STATE distinguishes unknown, disabled, queued, ready, and running states
semantic_limits: A running state does not identify the process or prove receipt production; ready does not mean healthy
